units.text: INT. SUPERMAN - CONTINUOUS

I rather think Rhoda is heading for a row with Ann. As a rule there is only one person an English girl hates more than she hates her mother; and that's her eldest sister. But Rhoda positively prefers her mother to Ann. She--
units.name: TANNER

units.text: indignantly.
Oh, I say!
units.name: TANNER

units.text: What's the matter?
units.name: OCTAVIUS

units.text: Rhoda was to have come with me for a ride in the motor car. She says Ann has forbidden her to go out with me.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: Straker suddenly begins whistling his favorite air with remarkable deliberation.
Surprised by this burst of larklike melody, and jarred by a sardonic note in its cheerfulness, they turn and look inquiringly at him.
But he is busy with his paper; and nothing comes of their movement.
recovering himself.
Does she give any reason?
units.name: OCTAVIUS

units.text: Reason! An insult is not a reason. Ann forbids her to be alone with me on any occasion. Says I am not a fit person for a young girl to be with. What do you think of your paragon now?
units.name: TANNER

units.text: You must remember that she has a very heavy responsibility now that her father is dead. Mrs Whitefield is too weak to control Rhoda.
units.name: OCTAVIUS

units.text: staring at him.
In short, you agree with Ann.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: No; but I think I understand her. You must admit that your views are hardly suited for the formation of a young girl's mind and character.
units.name: OCTAVIUS

units.text: I admit nothing of the sort. I admit that the formation of a young lady's mind and character usually consists in telling her lies; but I object to the particular lie that I am in the habit of abusing the confidence of girls.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: Ann doesn't say that, Jack.
units.name: OCTAVIUS

units.text: What else does she mean?
units.name: TANNER

units.text: catching sight of Ann coming from the house.
Miss Whitefield, gentlemen.
units.name: STRAKER

units.text: He dismounts and strolls away down the avenue with the air of a man who knows he is no longer wanted.
coming between Octavius and Tanner.
Good morning, Jack. I have come to tell you that poor Rhoda has got one of her headaches and cannot go out with you to-day in the car. It is a cruel disappointment to her, poor child!
units.name: ANN

units.text: What do you say now, Tavy.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: Surely you cannot misunderstand, Jack. Ann is showing you the kindest consideration, even at the cost of deceiving you.
units.name: OCTAVIUS

units.text: What do you mean?
units.name: ANN

units.text: Would you like to cure Rhoda's headache, Ann?
units.name: TANNER

units.text: Of course.
units.name: ANN

units.text: Then tell her what you said just now; and add that you arrived about two minutes after I had received her letter and read it.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: Rhoda has written to you!
units.name: ANN

units.text: With full particulars.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: Never mind him, Ann. You were right, quite right. Ann was only doing her duty, Jack; and you know it. Doing it in the kindest way, too.
units.name: OCTAVIUS

units.text: going to Octavius.
How kind you are, Tavy! How helpful! How well you understand!
units.name: ANN

units.text: Octavius beams.
Ay: tighten the coils. You love her, Tavy, don't you?
units.name: TANNER

units.text: She knows I do.
units.name: OCTAVIUS

units.text: Hush. For shame, Tavy!
units.name: ANN

units.text: Oh, I give you leave. I am your guardian; and I commit you to Tavy's care for the next hour.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: No, Jack. I must speak to you about Rhoda. Ricky: will you go back to the house and entertain your American friend? He's rather on Mamma's hands so early in the morning. She wants to finish her housekeeping.
units.name: ANN

units.text: I fly, dearest Ann
units.name: OCTAVIUS

units.text: he kisses her hand.
tenderly.
Ricky Ticky Tavy!
units.name: ANN

units.text: He looks at her with an eloquent blush, and runs off.
bluntly.
Now look here, Ann. This time you've landed yourself; and if Tavy were not in love with you past all salvation he'd have found out what an incorrigible liar you are.
units.name: TANNER
